declaration_scope: source lock for WDI predictive-search v2 model family, target split, candidate formulas, comparators, and scoring policy before heldout target scoring

candidate_formulas_declared_before_scori.rule: y_t = y_t-1 +/- max(1, abs(y_t-1)*1e-9); sign chosen from the last four prior same-series growth rates by the declared cycle-turning rules

comparator_baselines_declared_before_sco.name: WDI carry-forward last-observation comparator
comparator_baselines_declared_before_sco.prediction_rule: predict target year as the latest prior observed value

comparator_baselines_declared_before_sco.name: WDI prior-training mean comparator
comparator_baselines_declared_before_sco.prediction_rule: predict target year as the arithmetic mean of prior observed values

scoring_policy_declared_before_scoring.selection_scope: per target row; same-series years strictly earlier than heldout_year
scoring_policy_declared_before_scoring.selection_metric: mean absolute residual on prior one-step replay rows with declared cycle-guard override
scoring_policy_declared_before_scoring.cycle_guard_override_policy: when the best replay formula has nonzero prior replay error and a larger current step than cycle_guard_micro_trend, select the predeclared cycle guard; this uses only same-series history earlier than heldout_year
scoring_policy_declared_before_scoring.residual_metric: absolute residual; aggregate model residual is mean absolute residual
scoring_policy_declared_before_scoring.negative_control_policy: reject support unless every comparator baseline is worse than the selected model on every heldout row
scoring_policy_declared_before_scoring.uncertainty_policy: deterministic replay envelope over selected-model absolute residuals

materiality_policy.metric: absolute residual advantage over best preregistered comparator

row_gate.uncertainty_upper: row selected-formula prior replay uncertainty interval upper bound

materiality_policy.near_tie_policy: a strict comparator residual greater-than is insufficient; grand support requires both aggregate and every row-level best-comparator margin to meet the preregistered materiality thresholds

scoring_policy_declared_before_scoring.tamper_policy: heldout target mutation must change row hashes without changing same-row formula selection or prediction
scoring_policy_declared_before_scoring.support_gate_policy: grand_toe_support_allowed is true iff source lock, source separation, N, row validation, residual superiority, materiality, negative controls, tamper tests, pack gate, and strict schema all pass
